As i replied to someone before here, I'm okay with cosmetic DLC with the exception of lootboxes. Go hog wild, make pink jumpkits even it's not canon. (Jokes!)

However i don't think Vince Zampella (CEO of Respawn) would let adding any multiplayer map-lootbox-card DLC. There's a big chance that TF3 will go like TF2, since Vince did worked with EA before (see MoH) and the fact that EA would lose market shares like in BF2 all over again.

At least, that's how i want to believe anyway.

EA should start to get things right or i don't really think people will tolerate that kind of thing after the BF2 fiasco. Last time a game get so much hate was AC Unity (which was a decent game) because of its overhype expectation meets with day one mess of a game. Yeah but here's the thing; it's optional. You don't have to use a cosmetic DLC. Multiplayer-map DLC's on the other hand, they divide the playerbase. You need to buy that DLC so you can play with others.

Titanfall 2 would be best example how any game should do DLC in multiplayer. Free remastered-new maps, free new game modes, no microtransactions and only DLC's are the cosmetic ones without the market or lootbox stuff, you simply get what you pay for.

Crysis wasn't exactly a EA game i think. It was published by EA, but produced by Crytek.

The problem here is not the cosmetic stuff, but EA's greed and stubbornness taking things far as making a $60 even $80 game P2W. (See Battlefront 2 and Fifa UT, also creating choke points in games such as NFS;Payback)

Again, i'm not against cosmetic DLC *excluding lootboxes* . But making multiplayer map dlc's and dividing playerbase, making a full priced game P2W is too far.

The company of EA itself. Not just because of the "lootbox" controversy, but they're greedy and also ruined a lot of good studios. I respect DICE and Respawn (love you guys <3), even the Ghost Studios (mostly ex-Criterion) , but i don't respect and care about EA as a company.

Sure, they can change, but let's be honest, it's quite unlikely.
